verdict.rationale: BVNK documents API-driven fiat-to-crypto automation (linking a fiat virtual account to a blockchain address, auto on-ramping to crypto) and 'Embedded Wallets' that let partners offer wallet/payment functionality under their own branding, which supports an onramp-style integration. However, evidence shows bank-transfer/virtual-account based conversion rather than a documented card-payment option, and there is no explicit mention of a pre-built embeddable 'buy' widget for end users—only API/portal-based wallet and rule creation. Missing for 10: a documented UI widget/checkout component, explicit card-payment support for onramp, and end-user-facing purchase flow documentation.
